name: Magical Giants
description: Large humanoid beings of the Magic Realm, from Size +2 to about +6, usually boorish and cruel, affected by Corpus and Mentem and defined by the Gigantic Quality.

name: Goëmagot
description: A monstrous giant twelve cubits tall from Geoffrey of Monmouth's history, who slaughtered Britons with twenty companions.

name: Geoffrey of Monmouth
description: Historian (c. 1100-1154) who wrote the History of the Kings of Britain and claimed giants were Britain's original inhabitants.

name: Nephilim
description: Giants belonging to the Divine and Infernal Realms, described as 300 cubits tall (Size +18).

name: Primeval Giants
description: Immense giants of many mythologies, children of the Protogonoi and ancestors of Gods and Daimons, ranked by theurgists as kosmokrators; comparable in power to Archangels.

name: Protogonoi
description: Primal spirits whose children are the primeval giants; Ouranos, Ge and Ymir are examples.

name: Kosmokrators
description: A rank of primal spirit used to model primeval giants, beings the size of mountain ranges or larger.

name: Titans
description: In Greek myth the children of Ouranos and Ge; the six male Titans govern time in the Magic realm and their wives control natural forces.

name: Ouranos
description: Protogonos of Greek myth, father of the Titans with Ge.

name: Ge
description: Protogonos of Greek myth, mother of the Titans with Ouranos.

name: Hyperion
description: Titan who establishes day and night.

name: Krios
description: Titan who orders the heavenly constellations.

name: Koios
description: Titan who rules the axis of the heavens.

name: Iapetos
description: The Titan of mortality.

name: Kronos
description: Titan who rules all-devouring time.

name: Okeanos
description: Titan who regulates the motion of the tides.

name: Theia
description: Titaness who is the brilliant sky.

name: Eurybia
description: Titaness, mistress of the weather.

name: Phoibe
description: Titaness who is the prophetic earth.

name: Klymene
description: Titaness who is the underworld's cavern.

name: Rhea
description: Titaness who is the fecundity of nature.

name: Tethys
description: Titaness who is the power of the waters under the earth.

name: Ymir
description: The Protogonos of the Norse lands, a primordial giant slain by the gods whose body formed the world; progenitor of two races of kosmokrators.

name: Logi
description: Norse kosmokrator giant embodying devastating wild fire, of Ymir's first hostile brood.

name: Gymir
description: Norse kosmokrator giant of the icy winds of winter, of Ymir's first brood.

name: Aegir
description: Norse kosmokrator giant of the storm-lashed sea, of Ymir's first brood.

name: Mimir
description: Wise counselor of the gods, of Ymir's second, friendlier brood.

name: Urd
description: The Weaver, representing time and fate, of Ymir's second brood.

name: Natt
description: Daughter of Mimir and Urd, the all-enshrouding night.

name: Fomoire
description: The first inhabitants of Celtic lands, children of the chthonic titan Domnu.

name: Domnu
description: Chthonic titan of darkness and fertility, mother of the Fomoire.

name: Balor
description: All-seeing Fomoire with a baleful eye.

name: Indech
description: Fomoire king.

name: Cichol the Footless
description: One of the Fomoire.

name: Eithne
description: Prophetic member of the Fomoire.

name: Lot
description: Hideous ogress of the Fomoire.

name: Archangels
description: Mighty beings to which primeval giants are comparable in power.

name: Chrétien de Troyes
description: Author of epic poems about the Knights of the Round Table in which giants appear as brutish villains.

name: Knights of the Round Table
description: Heroes of medieval romances who fight giants.

name: Sir Yvain
description: Romance hero who struck the giant Harpin of Mountain in the face with his sword while mounted.

name: Harpin of Mountain
description: Giant from the romances, probably Size +3 or less.

name: Barcas
description: Example magical giant (Might 16 Terram), a boastful wrestler nearly invulnerable to metal except for a spot below his sternum; based on Ferragus.

name: Ferragus
description: A giant who fought Roland in the pseudo-Turpin romance; the basis for Barcas.

name: Roland
description: Hero of the History of the Life of Charlemagne and Roland who fought Ferragus.

name: Goliath of Gath
description: The most famous giant in Mythic Europe, from the Bible, nine and a half feet tall (Size +2).

name: Cain
description: Biblical figure; some folk believe giants are his accursed descendants.

name: Jotunnar
description: The Norse giants spawned from Ymir, including frost, mountain, sea, storm and fire giants; affiliated with elemental Forms and all possessing magical powers.

name: Frost Giants
description: Norse giants associated with Aquam that have Greater Immunity to cold.

name: Fire Giants
description: Norse giants dwelling in Muspelheim with Greater Immunity to fire.

name: Sea Giants
description: Norse giants who can breathe underwater.

name: Mountain Giants
description: Norse giants associated with Terram who have Terram Resistance.

name: Storm Giants
description: Norse giants with Auram Resistance and Lesser Immunity to lightning; Rok is one.

name: Trolls
description: Scandinavian trolls related to the Jotunnar: ugly or misshapen giants of Size +2 to +4, sometimes with claws or tusks.

name: Rok
description: A storm giant (Might 28 Auram) about 15 feet tall who conjures winds and hail; allied with a ship captain to raise storms against rival merchants.

name: Morag
description: A giant driven from his mountain home by diabolists who has taken to robbery and holds a knight hostage in a cave.

name: Diabolists
description: Infernal practitioners who drove the giant Morag from his home.

name: Spirit Votary
description: Free Supernatural Virtue making a character a Mythic Companion devoted to a magical spirit; grants Second Sight and requires Spiritual Pact and the Pagan Flaw.

name: Mythic Companion
description: A special type of character that takes the place of a player's magus character.

name: Spiritual Pact
description: Major Supernatural Virtue: a pact with a powerful Magical spirit letting the character channel a Might Pool to use the spirit's powers.

name: Might Pool
description: Pool of Might points spent to use supernatural powers; Spiritual Pact grants one without a Might score.

name: Lise
description: A Spirit Votary and Warped priestess of the Dark Mother, aged 129, who seeks revenge against the Church after mistreatment by a priest.

name: Dark Mother
description: A chthonic spirit of the deep forest and fertile earth who resents the Church; Lise is her only priestess.

name: Stasis
description: A spirit power that extends life; Lise lives under it but cannot leave a Magic aura without aging dramatically.

name: Magic Kin
description: Families or groups of characters aligned with Magic sharing inherited qualities and powers.

name: Atlanteans
description: Creatures of Magic living in the deep ocean; those brought to the surface are exiled from their society.

name: Atlantis
description: Drowned continent and sunken city said to be home to the Atlanteans and their king.

name: Mermaids
description: Sea beings whose stories Merinita magi believe derive from garbled tales of Atlanteans.

name: Pavania
description: A self-proclaimed princess of Atlantis caught by fishermen who demands magi remove 'the taint of the surface world.'

name: King of Atlantis
description: Pavania's father, ruler of sunken Atlantis.

name: Flame Dancers
description: Magic kin possessed by the power of fire who love fires and flesh and dance tirelessly around bonfires.

name: Forgotten Gods
description: Beasts and spirits once worshiped as gods who retreated into the Magic Realm or took living forms to survive the Dominion.

name: Mercere
description: Founder whom many in the Cult of Mercury believe was the god Mercury reborn.

name: Mercury
description: Roman god some believe was reborn as Mercere.

name: Jove
description: A Forgotten God, the ancient sky god, who lost his powers after taking Communion and now lives in a monastery.

name: Loamwalkers
description: Tree-spirits born in or able to take human form who represent the interests of forests in the mundane world.

name: Vinaria
description: Former Prima of House Merinita who in a story seed is revealed to be a Loamwalker on her death.

name: Ash
description: A trusted Redcap from The Broken Covenant of Calebais who may secretly be a Loamwalker.

name: Lost Children
description: Abandoned children left in Magic auras who become magical, unaging beings appearing aged five to 15.

name: Men of the Lake
description: Sentient water-elemental-like beings from magical lake regiones, organized by season and linked by a lake network.

name: Orphan Born
description: Humans engendered by dead parents and born beyond the veil, able to see spirits and become incorporeal.

name: People of the Clouds
description: Magical sailors of a sky-sea regio who fly ships with power over winds and have insatiable wanderlust.

name: The Stoneskinned
description: Magic kin bound to Terram who become living stone with age and are turned to stone by sunlight.

name: Warders of Mystery
description: A society of Auditores who believe magic diminishes as knowledge of it spreads and work to keep magic secret.

name: Transformed Humans
description: Humans transformed by magic into beings of the Magic Realm, losing their humanity.

name: Drowned Men
description: Sailors drowned and returned by a magical force as creatures of magic.

name: Burned and Buried Men
description: Persons saved from immolation or burial by magical creatures of Ignem or Terram, gaining Virtues like Drowned Men.

name: Thorstar
description: A lighthouse keeper on Geita, son of a Viking chieftain, saved and bound to his task by a magic fish since 912.

name: Revenants
description: The walking dead: animate corpses driven by a spirit, immune to fatigue and pain, tied to the living world by personal need.

name: Glam
description: A revenant from The Saga of Grettir the Strong who terrorized his district.

name: Grettir the Strong
description: Saga hero whose saga tells of the revenant Glam.

name: Ghosts
description: Disembodied spirits of the dead; animi. Revenants are sometimes considered a sub-class.

name: Daimons
description: Powerful genii dwelling in the Magic Realm, also called Named Spirits; human wizards may achieve apotheosis to become them.

name: Living Ghosts
description: Wizards who bind their own spirit to a location, becoming ghost-like while retaining will and magic.

name: Great Beasts
description: Magical beings Bjornaer magi may become in Final Twilight, with Might equal to 5 x Heartbeast.

name: Spirits
description: Beings of pure form with no matter, immortal and insensible to physical beings without powers; includes genii and animi.

name: Genius
description: Spirits created as such (never material), including Daimons and Airy Spirits.

name: Animus
description: Spirits that were created human but have ceased to be material beings.

name: Airy Spirits
description: Genii of the earth of much lesser power than Daimons.

name: Spell Spirits
description: Spirits summoned by Hermetic Theurgy initiates that duplicate a specific spell or Form.

name: Theoi
description: Spirits who were worshiped as gods, usually Winter characters.

name: Genius Loci
description: Spirit of a place whose Magic aura can spread; considered to touch plants and creatures within its domain.

name: Elementals
description: Non-sentient embodiments of pure elemental forces.

name: Angels
description: Genii of the Heavens, usually considered separate from genii.

name: Demons
description: Sublunar genii usually considered separate from other spirits.

name: Faeries
description: Beings with which giants sometimes ally; some took places of forgotten gods.

name: Forest Spirits
description: Spirits described in Guardians of the Forests whose powers are revised here.

name: Hedge Wizards
description: Non-Hermetic wizards with whom giants sometimes form alliances.

name: Theurgists
description: Practitioners of spirit magic who classify primeval giants as kosmokrators and pursue spiritual taxonomy.

name: Redcaps
description: Messengers of the Order of Hermes; the Broken Branches are a group of them.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House whose magi study faeries, including those of the sea.

name: House Diedne
description: House believed to have used the Men of the Lake network during the Schism War.

name: House Tremere
description: House of which five magi assaulted Lake Balaton late in the Schism War and never returned.

name: House Bjornaer
description: House whose magi in Final Twilight permanently assume their heartbeast forms.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Cult many of whose members believe Mercere was the god Mercury reborn.

name: Cult of Heroes
description: Cult whose beliefs hold Mercere was a man with the blood of the gods.

name: Broken Branches
description: A group of Redcaps united by love of nature, founded by a Loamwalker.

name: The Church
description: The Christian Church, which Lise seeks to destroy.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal with large forests where Loamwalkers are common.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal with large forests where Loamwalkers are common.

name: Calebais
description: The Broken Covenant of Calebais, home of the Redcap Ash.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica.

name: British Isles
description: Region where giants are especially prevalent.

name: Jotunheim
description: The land of the Norse giants, perhaps within the Magic Realm.

name: Muspelheim
description: The fiery prison where the fire giants dwell.

name: Midgard
description: The world, formed from Ymir; one of his eyebrows formed all of it.

name: Lake Balaton
description: Lake near Budapest home to Men of the Lake, site of a failed Tremere assault.

name: Loch Dee
description: Lake in Scotland inhabited by Men of the Lake.

name: Lake Constance
description: Lake in Germany inhabited by Men of the Lake.

name: Budapest
description: City near Lake Balaton.

name: Paris
description: City cited as the interest of a Men of the Lake societas.

name: Rome
description: Ancient city; the Auditores' title dates to before its fall.

name: Geita
description: Island at the head of the Vilnes Fjord with a lighthouse kept by Thorstar.

name: Vilnes Fjord
description: Fjord at whose head lies the island of Geita.

name: Yorkshire
description: Region with a tale that revenants are destroyed by stakes through their hearts.

name: Hall of Heroes
description: Destination of wizards who achieve apotheosis and become Daimons.

name: Twilight Void
description: Realm with Form provinces; Loamwalkers can see into its Herbam province through a tree's vestige.

name: Magic Realm
description: The supernatural realm of Magic to which giants, spirits and magic kin belong.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm of God to which the Nephilim partly belong.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of demons to which the Nephilim partly belong.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm to which some giants belong.

name: Dominion
description: The power of God's Church, which magical giants avoid and which drove forgotten gods into retreat.

name: Corpus
description: Form of the body; most giants and revenants are affected by it.

name: Mentem
description: Form of the mind; affects giants' minds and revenant spirits.

name: Terram
description: Form of earth; associated with mountain giants, Barcas and the Stoneskinned.

name: Aquam
description: Form of water; associated with frost/sea giants, Atlanteans and Men of the Lake.

name: Auram
description: Form of air; associated with storm giants such as Rok.

name: Ignem
description: Form of fire; creatures of Ignem may save a person from immolation.

name: Herbam
description: Form of plants; used by Loamwalker and spirit powers.

name: Animal
description: Form of animals; used by Decree of the Atlantean and Manifestation.

name: Imaginem
description: Form of images; used by Eidolon and Murmur of the Deep.

name: Vim
description: Form of magic itself; can affect revenant spirits and Might.

name: Creo
description: Technique of creation, e.g. Creo Auram effects conjured by Rok.

name: Rego
description: Technique of control; Rego Corpus spells animate corpses.

name: Perdo
description: Technique of destruction; Perdo Corpus spells often fail against revenants.

name: Might
description: A supernatural being's Might score (e.g. Magic Might), determining its Qualities and power.

name: Magic Qualities
description: Virtue-like traits (and Inferiorities) purchased by magic characters with their Might.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural distortion that can transform humans; Lise is severely Warped.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural region layered on the mundane world, such as magic lake regiones.

name: Rune Magic
description: Norse magic practiced by some giants.

name: Size
description: Characteristic determining height and weight; three points is about a tenfold mass difference.

name: Confidence Score
description: Score of Confidence points a character may spend.

name: Season (character)
description: Spring, Summer, Autumn or Winter maturity category for magic characters.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power found in creatures' bodies, e.g. Corpus vis in a giant's skull.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A magical link to a person or place; Spiritual Pact and Material Anchor create them.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Protection that powers must penetrate.

name: Penetration
description: Ability and measure of overcoming Magic Resistance.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura; Magic auras shelter forgotten gods and lost children.

name: Mystery Cults
description: Secret initiatory groups; some pursue apotheosis or living ghosthood.

name: The Gift
description: The magical talent of magi.

name: Schism War
description: War in the Order during which House Diedne may have used the lake network.

name: Mercere Portal
description: A network of magical portals of House Mercere for travel across Mythic Europe.

name: Societas
description: An ad hoc interest group an autumn Man of the Lake joins.

name: Vestige Travel
description: Travel through a vestige into the Twilight Void.

name: Apotheosis
description: The process of becoming an immortal spirit, goal of several mystery cults.

name: Final Twilight
description: Permanent Twilight in which magi vanish or transform into magical beings.

name: Hermetic Theurgy
description: Mystery allowing initiates to summon spell spirits.

name: Invisible World
description: The world of spirits, known to magi and wizards.

name: Silent Speech
description: A spirit's communication with physical beings.

name: Species
description: Sensory emanations of informed matter; spirits produce none.

name: Aspect
description: A Daimon's manifestation that can be destroyed.

name: Water-way
description: Special Atlantean range, with special Duration Storm and Target Body-of-water.

name: True Faith
description: Divine faith; Jove has it alongside Magical powers.

name: Old Ways
description: Pagan traditions in which Lise was raised.

name: Gigantic
description: Major Magic Quality granting giant Size, increasing Strength and reducing Quickness.

name: Giant Blood
description: Virtue for humans with some giant heritage; not for true giants.

name: Greater Immunity
description: Virtue granting immunity, e.g. to cold, fire, iron or drowning.

name: Lesser Immunity
description: Virtue granting minor immunity, e.g. to lightning.

name: Ways of the (Land)
description: Virtue suggested for giants; Lise has Ways of the Forest.

name: Animal Ken
description: Virtue suggested for giants.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Virtue suggested for giants.

name: Berserk
description: Virtue; Rok has it.

name: Puissant (Ability)
description: Virtue boosting an Ability, e.g. Puissant Brawl.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Virtue suggested for giants.

name: Sharp Ears
description: Virtue suggested for giants.

name: Tough
description: Virtue suggested for giants.

name: Warrior
description: Virtue suggested for giants.

name: Magic Human
description: Virtue defining a human-like magic being.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Virtue granting Arcane Abilities; Rok has it.

name: Skinchanger
description: Virtue for shapechanging; Surface Form is a version of it.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Virtue for changing shape.

name: Divination and Augury
description: Powers some wise Norse giants possess.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural Ability/Virtue to see spirits and through illusions.

name: Wise One
description: Virtue held by Lise.

name: Entrancement
description: Supernatural Virtue and Ability held by Lise.

name: Affinity with (Ability)
description: Virtue boosting learning of an Ability, e.g. Magic Lore.

name: Great (Characteristic)
description: Virtue raising a characteristic; Lise has Great Presence twice.

name: Premonitions
description: Virtue and Ability of foreseeing danger.

name: Self Confident
description: Virtue held by Lise.

name: Atlantean Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue from studying exiled Atlanteans' magic, with special ranges, durations and targets.

name: Surface Form
description: Inherited Atlantean Virtue, a version of Skinchanger.

name: Voice of the (Ocean)
description: Inherited Atlantean Virtue.

name: Magical Blood
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue for a child of an exiled Atlantean.

name: Unaging
description: Inherited Virtue of Lost Children.

name: (Lake) Regio Network
description: Inherited Virtue of Men of the Lake.

name: Ghostly Warder
description: Virtue of a ghost watching over a character.

name: Transformed (Being)
description: Major Supernatural Virtue gained by Drowned Men.

name: Magic Spirit
description: Inherited Virtue of spirit characters.

name: Magical Focus
description: Hermetic Virtue that may shape a magus' Final Twilight transformation.

name: Improved Soak
description: Magic Quality increasing Soak.

name: Improved Might
description: Magic Quality increasing Might.

name: Personal Power
description: Magic Quality granting a personal-range power.

name: Greater Power
description: Magic Quality granting a major power.

name: Lesser Power
description: Magic Quality granting a minor power.

name: Focus Power
description: Magic Quality granting a flexible focus power.

name: Ritual Power
description: Magic Quality granting a ritual-like power.

name: Improved Powers
description: Magic Quality reducing power costs.

name: No Fatigue
description: Magic Quality making revenants tireless.

name: Variable Powers
description: Magic Quality letting powers scale with age or Might.

name: Terram Resistance
description: Quality and Ability of mountain giants and Barcas.

name: Auram Resistance
description: Quality and Ability of storm giants.

name: Small Frame
description: Flaw contradictory for giants.

name: Dwarf
description: Flaw contradictory for giants.

name: Avaricious
description: Personality Flaw; Rok's major flaw.

name: Compassionate
description: Personality Flaw option for giants.

name: Greedy
description: Personality Flaw option for giants.

name: Proud
description: Personality Flaw for giants and Forgotten Gods.

name: Fury
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Greater Malediction
description: Flaw of Lost Children and the Stoneskinned.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Flaw, e.g. Barcas's vulnerable spot.

name: Outlaw
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Wanderlust
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Afflicted Tongue
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Feral Upbringing
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Hunchback
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Infamous
description: Flaw; Men of the Lake have a Hermetic reputation.

name: Poor Intelligence
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Simple Minded
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Weakness
description: Flaw, e.g. Barcas's weakness for alcohol.

name: Weak-Willed
description: Flaw suggested for giants.

name: Wrathful
description: Minor Flaw of the typical giant.

name: Overconfident
description: Minor Flaw of Barcas.

name: Obese
description: Flaw affecting weight.

name: Susceptible to Deprivation
description: Magic Inferiority of giants.

name: Pagan
description: Flaw balancing Spirit Votary; common for Forgotten Gods.

name: Restriction
description: Flaw; Lise must be in contact with earth.

name: Poor
description: Flaw.

name: Driven
description: Flaw held by Lise.

name: Visions
description: Flaw from Warping.

name: Exiled Atlantean
description: Inherited Flaw of Atlanteans.

name: Monstrous Appearance
description: Flaw of the Atlantean character guide.

name: Obsessed
description: Flaw, e.g. returning to sea.

name: Age Quickly
description: Common Flaw of Flame Dancers.

name: Compulsion
description: Flaw; Flame Dancers' compulsions involve fire.

name: Dark Secret
description: Flaw; being a Loamwalker.

name: Essential Flaw
description: Flaw; Loamwalkers have Antisocial.

name: Fear
description: Flaw, e.g. of fire.

name: Baneful Circumstances
description: Inferiority, e.g. revenants in daylight.

name: Social Handicap
description: Flaw; Lost Children act like children.

name: Magical Air
description: Flaw all spirits have; common for Orphan Born.

name: Magical Companion
description: Flaw; Orphan Born have ghostly companions.

name: Monstrous Blood
description: Flaw common to Orphan Born (spirit).

name: Arthritis
description: Common Flaw of the Stoneskinned.

name: Nocturnal
description: Common Flaw of the Stoneskinned.

name: Servant of the Ocean
description: Major Story Flaw of Drowned Men.

name: Weak Characteristics
description: Flaw of the skeletal revenant.

name: Reduced Abilities
description: Inferiority common among spirits.

name: Brawl
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Great Weapon
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Living Language
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Carouse
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Craft
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Leadership
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Survival
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Concentration
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Single Weapon
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Chirurgy
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Forest Lore
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Guile
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Hunt
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Music
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Profession
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Stealth
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Swim
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Bargain
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Finesse
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Heartbeast
description: Ability used in character statistics in this text.

name: Invulnerability to Metal
description: Barcas's power making him immune to metal weapons except one vulnerable spot.

name: Master of Fierce Winds
description: Rok's Focus Power to spontaneously conjure Creo Auram winds or hail.

name: Charge of the Angry Winds
description: ArM5 spell whose effect Rok creates to scatter foes.

name: Gathering of the Stormy Might
description: Spell/power of Rok, used at Sight range on a Group.

name: True Sight of the Air
description: Spell/power continuously active for Rok.

name: Crafter of Earth
description: Terram spirit power used by Lise.

name: Enliven the Gross Earth
description: Terram spirit power used by Lise.

name: Guide
description: Mentem spirit power used by Lise.

name: Eidolon
description: Spirit power creating an illusory visible and audible form.

name: Ruler of Plants
description: Herbam spirit power used by Lise.

name: Decree of the Atlantean
description: Atlantean power summoning a water creature within the same water-way.

name: Murmur of the Deep
description: Atlantean power to hear from any point in the same water-way.

name: Let the Bonfire Burn
description: Flame Dancer power setting fire to a slightly inflammable target.

name: Endurance of the Flame Dancer
description: Flame Dancer power to feel unwounded and unfatigued until sunrise or sunset.

name: Endurance of the Berserkers
description: ArM5 spell referenced by Endurance of the Flame Dancer.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: Spell/Focus Power letting a character contribute levels to a spell cast with Communion.

name: From Hill to Hollow
description: Loamwalker power to move instantly between trees within sight.

name: Stance of the Patient Tree
